hypothesis: Static sparse support posteriors inside overlapping restarted cohorts can adapt without erasing established support after a few noisy observations.
comparators: matched single persistent cohort with the same null prior
secondary_ablation: v4 continual fixed-share versus v4 birth-only rejuvenation; same cohort states

evaluation.promotion: Require lower change error than both matched single-cohort and v3-static controls, with no stationary/null regression against v3-static on this seed. Treat this as an engineering screen, not statistical significance. Publish all named outputs and censored horizons.

limitations: Deterministic geometric restarts are not inferred changepoints
Specialist probabilities are aggregation weights, not exact joint Bayesian posteriors
No stock, neural-network, or MuJoCo transfer claim
